articles.title: XRP rebounds above $1.30 after volume surge, but bears still control the bigger picture
articles.snippet: XRP snapped a streak of lower lows on heavy buying, though the token remains stuck below major resistance levels that have capped every rally this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
articles.snippet: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.

articles.title: Bitcoin's record holder supply hides a buyer drought, CryptoQuant says
articles.snippet: A record high in long-term holder supply typically signals conviction. CryptoQuant says it reflects a shortage of new buyers, a view echoed by weakening ETF demand and bearish prediction market odds.

articles.title: Strategy situation ‘out of hand,’ says Arca exec on $15B preferred stock burden
articles.snippet: Strategy’s capital structure may be under pressure as Arca’s Jeff Dorman highlights $15 billion in preferred stock obligations and CEO comments on possible Bitcoin sales.

articles.title: SEC approves Paxos as ‘blockchain-native’ clearing agency
articles.snippet: Paxos says its approval as a blockchain-focused clearing agency represents a “critical piece of financial market infrastructure” as Wall Street becomes more interested in crypto.
